values.title: MONSMECTA's 3 Core Promises
values.desc: We become a reliable benchmark for veterinary directors' clinical and managerial trust.
values.online_desc: We promise never to distribute to online malls, open markets, social commerce, or general offline pet shops. You can maintain prescription authority exclusively through animal hospitals.
values.price_desc: We guarantee a reasonable supply price, allowing directors to set the actual retail price autonomously. Overwhelming margin rates provide vitality to hospital management.
values.formula_desc: High-purity ultra-fine nano montmorillonite and Bacillus subtilis strain are formulated in high concentrations to buffer gastric acid (pH 4.5~5.5), relieve pain, and adsorb 98.5% of harmful substances, toxins, and viruses upon administration.

clinical.title: Evidence Proposed by Vets for Vets
clinical.card1_desc: Monsmecta's core ultra-fine process delivers overwhelming performance compared to conventional antidiarrheal raw materials.
clinical.card2_desc: Test results based on academic evidence from Prof. Lee Hu-jang's research team at Gyeongsang National University College of Veterinary Medicine.
clinical.card3_desc: DNJ produced by Bacillus subtilis MORI, the core strain of DNG-1000, shows inhibitory effects across multiple virus families.
clinical.card4_desc: Monsmecta is currently being validated through review meetings with veterinary experts.
clinical.card4_quote1: "The multiple viral inhibitory effects of 1-Deoxynojirimycin (DNJ) and differentiated adsorption capacity for harmful substances are clear differentiators."
clinical.card4_quote1_author: Prof. Park Bong-kyun (Former Director of Animal and Plant Quarantine Agency, Authority in Virology)
clinical.card4_quote2: "Particle size, moisture absorption, specific surface area... it has all the data veterinarians want."
clinical.card4_quote3: "Beyond simple diarrhea treatment, it provides exceptional palatability even for vomiting pets and instant pain relief. Essential as a 1st-line first-aid care for all digestive issues."
clinical.card4_quote3_author: Dr. Kim Dong-jun (Director of Sarang Animal Hospital)
clinical.card4_quote4: "I think this would be good for humans as well..."
clinical.card4_quote4_author: Prof. Hwa-young Youn (Former Prof. of Internal Medicine, SNU College of Vet Medicine · Former Head of SNU Animal Hospital Internal Medicine)
clinical.card4_note: Monsmecta's academic and advisory board consists of veterinary medicine experts including former graduates of Seoul National University College of Veterinary Medicine, thoroughly verifying clinical data and prescription criteria.

clinical.title: Academic Evidence & Clinical Trial Data
clinical.card1_desc: Monsmecta's core ultra-fine technology demonstrates overwhelming performance compared to conventional antidiarrheal raw materials.
clinical.techSummaryBody: By achieving over 8x surface area (≥800 m²/g) and 50x ultra-fine particle size (≤6.5 µm) compared to general montmorillonite, physical adsorption and toxin excretion performance are maximized.
clinical.paperRef1: Global Research Papers on Smectite & Montmorillonite Adsorption
clinical.card2_desc: Test results based on academic evidence from Gyeongsang National University College of Veterinary Medicine.
clinical.table2_row3_cond: Clinical experience with ~6,000 cases of parvo enteritis
clinical.card3_desc: Inhibitory effect by virus strain of DNJ component produced by Bacillus subtilis MORI, the core strain of DNG-1000.
clinical.antiviralSummaryBody: Proven that DNJ component from Bacillus subtilis MORI significantly suppresses proliferation of 5 major virus lineages in cattle, swine, and poultry.
